name: Ashtanga Yoga Chile (Santiago)
reason: No published email and no contact form: its own site (ashtangayogachile.com; robots.txt allows us) offers only WhatsApp links (api.whatsapp.com) for questions, across the home, school, plans, classes, getting-started and location pages. Otherwise a fair candidate: school in Ñuñoa since 2000, Mysore, led and intro classes, monthly plans priced from $40.000, online plans. The site also frames Ashtanga as a health tool and runs a 'Yogi Gym' strength programme (would be left out).
